about: The shared cases of the Library's filters (contract 2.0.0-p, docs/API.md "Library filters").
The server (web/tests/Feature/Api/LibraryFacetsFixtureTest.php), the desktop and the phone all read this file and must get these counts.
Each recording is a library item as the apps hold it (its facets are what the server sends) plus the stored fields the server derives them from.
The clock stands at `now`; dates are counted in `tz`. A recording that is `deleted` or still `recording` is never in the list or the counts; one still recording does count in Needs you.
Each filter set's `expect.facets` gives, for each section, the count of each option with every other section's filter applied and not its own, in the panel's order.

Search: every word somewhere among the title, the transcript text and the project path (the project's name and the names of the folders above it), ignoring capitals; the words may be in different places.
`bookmarks` lists the tag of each bookmark (null for one without a tag): a library item's `marker_count` is how many and its `tags` the tags.
